market.question: Named storm forms before hurricane season?

assessment.reasoning: No named storms have formed in 2026 Atlantic. ~32 days remain (to May 31). Climatological base rate for pre-season May named storms is roughly 25-30% in recent years; 2025 had no preseason storm (first was June 23). Nothing currently brewing. NHC routine outlooks don't begin until May 15.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Warm SSTs could spawn late-May system; 12-30 day forecasting limited
